description: Henrico County’s Top Prosecutor Shannon Taylor slammed Rob Wittman for recent statement about how the OBBB “helps everybody.” In voting for this bill, Wittman voted for the largest healthcare cuts in history — a bill that is already doubling and tripling premiums, stripping Virginians of coverage, and pushing rural hospitals toward closure. With that same vote, he handed himself one of the largest tax breaks of any member of Congress.

title: Rob Wittman Says His Vote to Gut Health Care and Slash His Own Taxes “Helps Everybody” - Shannon Taylor for Virginia
